the-passing-of-new-france-a-chronicle-of: William Wood chronicles the fall of French Canada through the story of Montcalm — the gallant general who died defending Quebec in 1759. The clash of empires on the Plains of Abraham unfolds with narrative power. A classic of Canadian history, telling one of the continent's turning points.
malcolm: George MacDonald's Scottish novel follows young Malcolm, a fisher lad of noble blood, through love and mystery on the Moray coast. The author's deep faith and poetic heart shine throughout. A beloved classic of Scottish fiction. Fisher folk, lairds, and hidden heirs move through this warm tale of the Scottish coast.
